annotations.title: Search FDA Recalls, Warning Letters & Global Product Safety

description: Search U.S. FDA regulatory enforcement actions, pharmaceutical/device/food recalls, FDA GMP inspection Warning Letters, or global CPSC and EU Safety Gate consumer product recalls.

category.description: Product category when datasetType is fda_recalls.

datasetType.description: Distinct regulatory dataset: fda_recalls (openFDA Class I-III recalls), fda_warning_letters (FDA GMP inspection letters), or global_consumer_recalls (US CPSC, USDA FSIS & EU Safety Gate).

maxResults.description: Maximum number of regulatory compliance records to return.

searchQuery.description: Optional company name, active ingredient, violation subject, or hazard keyword.

name: search_fda_and_product_safety_compliance
